About the Organization

C.O.W.S.A.G.A.
Concept of One World
Social Action for Global Awareness

C · Concept  ·  O · One World  ·  W · World  ·  S · Social  ·  A · Action  ·  G · Global  ·  A · Awareness

C.O.W.S.A.G.A. is a California nonprofit corporation founded in May 2026 by Vishnu Vardhan Manjunath — an Indian-American entrepreneur, global visionary, and lifelong devotee of the ancient Vedic principle of Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam: The World Is One Family.

Our mission is to advance global cultural awareness, interfaith dialogue, international cooperation, and the social and economic empowerment of all peoples through permanent, institution-scale action. Each letter of our name carries a living mandate: Concept of One World affirms the foundational unity of humanity; Social Action commits us to build, not merely speak; and Global Awareness is both our method and our mission.

Project Mini World — a proposed permanent 500-acre international cultural campus in California representing all 195 sovereign nations — is our flagship initiative and the most ambitious cultural infrastructure project proposed in the United States in the modern era.

Our Vision

A Permanent Home
for All of Humanity

Project Mini World is not a world's fair — world's fairs end. Not a museum — museums are the past. Not a theme park — theme parks are fiction. It is a permanent, living, breathing institution where every nation on Earth has an equal home, forever.

"You cannot hate someone whose story you know. You cannot bomb a people whose music you have danced to. You cannot starve a nation whose mother you have met."
— Vishnu Vardhan Manjunath, Founder & President, C.O.W.S.A.G.A.
🌍

Permanent

195 national pavilions built to last generations — an eternal institution of civilization open every day, forever.

⚖️

Equal

The smallest island nation stands beside the largest superpower — equal, permanent, and celebrated. No nation greater or lesser.

🕊️

Peace

The first generation that grows up knowing 195 nations as neighbors will be the generation that chooses peace.

Global Awareness Strategy

Ten Consortiums
Creating World Awareness

C.O.W.S.A.G.A. advances its mission through ten specialized global consortiums — each mobilizing a distinct sector of society to build, fund, promote, and propagate Project Mini World and world peace.

01
🌐

Global Cultural Diplomacy Consortium

Engaging all 195 nations, embassies, cultural ministries, and foreign affairs offices to secure permanent pavilion partnerships and MOU signings.

02
💰

World Philanthropy Consortium

Uniting the world's top philanthropists, foundations, and impact investors behind a civilization-scale investment in permanent global peace infrastructure.

03
💻

Global Technology & Innovation Consortium

Partnering with world-leading technology companies to build Mini World's digital backbone — AI, streaming, multilingual platforms, and smart campus systems.

04
🎵

World Arts & Entertainment Consortium

Mobilizing the global music, film, sports, and entertainment industry to perform, broadcast, and create from the world's greatest permanent cultural stage.

05
🏥

Global Health & Science Consortium

Connecting medical researchers, pharmaceutical leaders, and public health champions across 195 nations to share life-saving knowledge freely across all borders.

06
🕊️

Interfaith & Spiritual Leaders Consortium

Uniting religious leaders of all traditions to bless, guide, and participate in building the world's most sacred permanent interfaith institution.

07
👶

Global Youth & Education Consortium

Building the world's first global citizenship curriculum, youth exchange programs, and school partnerships — raising the Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam Generation.

08
🌱

Climate & Sustainability Consortium

Designing Mini World as the world's most ambitious net-zero permanent campus, showcasing ecological wisdom and sustainable innovation from all 195 nations.

09
📺

Global Media & Advocacy Consortium

Mobilizing journalists, broadcasters, social media creators, and storytellers worldwide to amplify the Mini World message to billions of people on every platform.

10
🏛️

Government & Public Policy Consortium

Engaging federal, state, and international governments — from the White House and GO-Biz to the United Nations — for policy support, funding, and partnership.
